name: goal1_budget_sweep
description: Goal 1: given a budget, minimise embarrassment while staying under it long-term. Players, C, days and seeds are held fixed so the budget is the only thing that varies. The values straddle a measured cliff rather than a slope: four greedy roommates at C=40 spend about $22,500 over 3600 days (they toss leftovers whenever leftover money still covers a $10 pack), so anything at or above that is indistinguishable from unlimited, and anything below it exhausts and never recovers - once there is no money for a $10 pack the drawer only shrinks. The rungs are dense around $22,000-$23,000 because that is where the knee sits; below $15,000 the run is already lost and the extra detail buys nothing. 3600 days because a single year is too short for the endgame to appear at all.
